## "parent_guids"

**Data type:**  
List of strings

**Value:**  
Example: ["7e8-6-0a-08-32-39-0-002-03-000-048fe2-00000"] 

**Description of metadata field:**  
This is the name (asset_guid) of the parent assets in the case of derivatives (e.g., a cropped and downsampled jpg derived from a tif).It  lets us easily locate the unprocessed parent image, allows us to link related assets and allows us to filter when searching for assets.

**Populated by whom and when:**  
Integration server when running pipeline.

**Updated where and when:**  
Never.

**Generated by:**  
Integration server when pipeline processes are run.

**Maps to in ARS:**  
parent_guid

**Maps to in Specify:**  
None

**Notes and issues:**  
None
